items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: I mean, no doubt in my mind that... There might have been a few that also loved the music. Like, I guess, Rupp liked the music.

ctx.x: Rupp. No, yeah. And Lou Chudden and those people.

I mean, no doubt in my mind that... There might have been a few that also loved the music. Like, I guess, Rupp liked the music. And people like that. But I don't know that they did it because they loved the music. A few, maybe, but not... I mean, these guys... The guys who did it because they loved the music... You're aware of them. What's his name that came down for Decca? The Commodore recordings and all. Who was the guy I'm thinking of? Decca? I don't know.
